about: check-size.mts --budgets: gzip bytes the browser downloads, per class, from dist/ after npm run build. A size over its budget fails; a size more than 5% under fails until the budget is lowered, so budgets only go down. Set 2026-11-04 from the fork's main at about 1% over the measured size.  Rebalanced when entry.ts started importing the game on demand: the old boot chunks moved from boot to lazy; boot + lazy + entry did not grow.
